Section 1 of 6
Form title
Engineering Ladies Initiative x AltSchool





 
 
 
 
 
 
Form description
The Engineering Ladies Initiative (ELI), in partnership with AltSchool, is offering an incredible opportunity for female Nigerian university students: fully and partially funded scholarships to learn at AltSchool.

This initiative is designed to equip women with the skills they need to thrive in today’s digital world. By filling out this form, you’ll stay informed and receive all the details you need to apply when applications officially open.

Want to stay in the loop? Follow us on all social media platforms @eliunilag for the latest updates and important announcements. 💕

Don’t wait—take the first step today! Let’s build the future together. ✨

Engineering Ladies Initiative x AltSchool
The Engineering Ladies Initiative (ELI), in partnership with AltSchool, is offering an incredible opportunity for female Nigerian university students: fully and partially funded scholarships to learn at AltSchool.

This initiative is designed to equip women with the skills they need to thrive in today’s digital world. By filling out this form, you’ll stay informed and receive all the details you need to apply when applications officially open.

Want to stay in the loop? Follow us on all social media platforms @eliunilag for the latest updates and important announcements. 💕

Don’t wait—take the first step today! Let’s build the future together. ✨
